name: Domain Microsite by Path
description: Makes microsites using Domain records at subpaths of existing domains.
project_description: Domain Microsite by Path builds "microsites" at sub-paths of an existing hostname (for example example.com/marketing) on top of the contrib Domain module. A microsite is an ordinary Domain config entity carrying three third-party settings (is_domain_microsite, parent_domain_id, base_path). The module implements hook_domain_request_alter() to recognise a microsite by the incoming request path and set it as the active domain, and a path processor (DomainMicrositePathProcessor) that strips the base path from inbound paths and prepends it to outbound URLs, so a microsite behaves like a Domain-negotiated site without needing its own hostname. Content scoping, theming and other per-domain behaviour come from the wider Domain ecosystem (Domain Access, Domain Source, Domain Config, etc.); this module only handles the path-based negotiation and URL rewriting. This is the 2.x development branch: no stable release is tagged and the info.yml carries no version. The project page lists it as seeking a new maintainer with no further development planned.
